server.name: io.github.dosev-ai/mcp-office-word
server.description: 50-tool Word MCP server. Document assembly, tracked changes, and export. Windows-first.
server.title: MCP Office Word

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access. Required — no files are accessible without this.
environmentVariables.name: WORD_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations (document content editing and styles).
environmentVariables.name: WORD_ENABLE_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: manage_tracked_changes and export_document (PDF/HTML). Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft Word.
environmentVariables.name: WORD_ENABLE_COM

server.name: io.github.dosev-ai/mcp-office-excel
server.description: 65-tool Excel MCP server. Read, write, format, and export .xlsx files. Windows-first.
server.title: MCP Office Excel

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access. Required — no files are accessible without this.
environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations (cell writes, sheet creation, formatting).
environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ENABLE_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: recalculate_workbook, export_as_pdf, hydrate_template, pivot_table, and evaluate_formula(live=True). Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft Excel.
environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ENABLE_COM

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of rows/items returned per call. Default: 50.
environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_MAX_ITEMS

server.name: io.github.dosev-ai/mcp-office-powerpoint
server.description: 46-tool PowerPoint MCP server. Build, edit, and export .pptx files. Windows-first.
server.title: MCP Office PowerPoint

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access. Required — no files are accessible without this.
environmentVariables.name: PPT_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations (slide editing and shape creation).
environmentVariables.name: PPT_ENABLE_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: export_slide, export_deck, run_slide_show, recalculate_charts, export_changed_slides_only. Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft PowerPoint.
environmentVariables.name: PPT_ENABLE_COM
